description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.5, §5.7): a rockfall seals the drowned kings' vault under the broken causeway (the quest starts when the giant finds the causeway or the vault, or comes within 120 m of it). A giant of stage 5 heaves it aside and walks the vault: 100 XP; the vault holds lore, 2 iron (its cache) and a cairn.

stages.objective: Heave the rockfall from the causeway's vault
stages.waiting_text: The rockfall will not move for a giant below stage 5.
